about: Named colours for identity records (sRGB). Dyes and materials a port of c. 1519 could plausibly show: undyed and bleached linen, natural and dyed wools (russet, brown, grey, woad blue, madder red, black for those who could pay for it), leathers, felt and straw (CHARACTER_ART §21, ART_BIBLE §4). Skin and hair colours are the record's own and are listed here only where several people share one.
